meta: Every AI demo video looks smooth because it's the best run picked out: here's how to check for yourself before you believe it.

muc.title: Smooth demo, bumpy reality
muc.text: Every AI demo video looks smooth because it's the best run picked out, sometimes even edited together.

muc.title: Look for the cuts
muc.text: Watch for scene cuts, fast-forwarding, and the small print in the bottom corner of the screen.

muc.title: Use your own task
muc.text: The surest way is to test it with your own real task, not the exact demo example. Try three times to see if results are consistent.

muc.title: Wait for real users
muc.text: If a feature isn't open to everyone yet, wait a few weeks and read real users' reviews before paying.

muc.title: One task to test
muc.text: Think back to an AI demo you just watched and write down one task of your own to test it with.
